final: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_average FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), above_overall AS (SELECT production_type_code, type_average FROM type_averages WHERE type_average > (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL)), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_average) AS mean_type_average FROM above_overall), remaining AS (SELECT type_average FROM above_overall WHERE type_average > (SELECT mean_type_average FROM kept_mean)) SELECT AVG(type_average) AS avg_type_average_price, AVG(type_average - (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL)) AS avg_above_overall_average, AVG(type_average - (SELECT mean_type_average FROM kept_mean)) AS avg_above_kept_types_mean FROM remaining
